te: Proposals after the incident involving Thai fishing boats in the Andaman Sea, and progress on the draft longan law
se: The meeting noted that the fisheries subcommittee had invited the Department of Fisheries to give information on the incident involving Thai fishing boats in the area of overlapping maritime claims with Myanmar, and had proposed that the government and the agencies concerned urgently work for the return of the 31 crew members and the boats to Thailand, organise patrols with maritime security agencies on both the Gulf of Thailand and Andaman sides, add the overlapping area boundaries to the vessel monitoring system, and provide relief for those affected. It also noted that the subcommittee on the draft longan strategy law had invited agricultural and trade agencies to give information on measures in line with the draft law
it: Proposals of the Subcommittee on Fisheries for the Study of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015) following the incident involving Thai fishing boats in the Andaman Sea
Progress of the subcommittee studying the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. ....

te: Fisheries subcommittee completes every section, and site visits on fisheries and longan reported
se: The meeting noted that the fisheries subcommittee has finished considering its draft study report on the draft law amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance, and will invite the Department of Fisheries and maritime security agencies to discuss the incident involving Thai fishing boats in the Andaman Sea, together with the results of site visits to Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket. The subcommittee on the draft longan strategy law reported on its visits to Sa Kaeo, Chanthaburi and Rayong, which found problems with production costs, labour, and production and marketing standards
it: Progress of the Subcommittee on Fisheries for the Study of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015): draft report complete, and results of site visits
Progress of the subcommittee studying the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. ....: results of site visits

te: Draft fisheries law on penalties and licences, and draft longan law on agencies' duties
se: The meeting noted that the fisheries subcommittee has considered draft sections 30–36 of the draft law amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance, on acts treated as serious violations, penalties, the transfer of fishing licences to heirs, fees and transitional provisions; and that the subcommittee on the draft longan strategy law has considered draft sections 16–18, on the duty of the Office of Agricultural Economics to monitor the longan strategy and master plan, and will invite agencies to give information
it: Progress of the Subcommittee on Fisheries for the Study of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015) (draft sections 30–36)
Progress of the subcommittee studying the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. .... (draft sections 16–18)

te: The Surat Thani shellfish farmers' matter followed up, and progress on the draft fisheries and longan laws
se: The meeting followed up the request for fair treatment in the allocation of shellfish farming areas in Mueang Surat Thani District, where the province has assigned the provincial fisheries office to establish the facts, and the committee will follow up the outcome. It also noted that the fisheries subcommittee has considered the draft law amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance up to draft section 29 and plans site visits to Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket, and that the subcommittee on the draft longan strategy law has considered draft sections 1–16 and plans visits to longan-growing areas
it: Request for fair treatment over the allocation of shellfish farming areas, Mueang Surat Thani District
Progress of the Subcommittee on Fisheries for the Study of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015)
Progress of the subcommittee studying the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. ....

te: Preparing a visit to the North after the floods, and following up farmland in 13 cooperative settlements and 14 forests
se: The meeting discussed a trip to follow up the effects of the floods on agriculture and livestock in Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai and Lamphun Provinces on 11–14 November 2024. It invited the Cooperative Promotion Department, the Office of the National Land Policy Board, the Royal Forest Department and representatives of the network of 13 cooperative settlements in 14 forests to give information on title documents for farmland in degraded national forest reserves under the Cabinet resolutions of 1970 and 1974, where the revocation of forest status is still held up. The committee asked the responsible agencies to act promptly under the law
it: Trip to follow up the effects of the floods on agriculture in the North (11–14 November 2024)
Farmland of the network of 13 cooperative settlements in 14 forests

te: Issues set for discussion with the Ministry of Agriculture, from farmers' debt to taking fishing boats out of the system
se: The meeting set issues for discussion with executives of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives, such as reviewing the use of the Farmers Rehabilitation and Development Fund Act B.E. 2542 (1999) and the management of farmers' debt, strengthening community enterprises, compensation for taking fishing boats out of the system, raising livestock standards and the ministry's strategic plans. It also noted the progress of the subcommittees on fisheries and on the draft longan strategy law
it: Issues for discussion with the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives: farmers' debt · community enterprises · taking fishing boats out of the system · livestock standards
Progress of the Subcommittee on Fisheries for the Study of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015) and of the subcommittee studying the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. ....

te: Issues prepared for discussion with the Ministry of Agriculture, and the subcommittees' plans noted
se: The meeting prepared key issues for its discussion with executives of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives on 8 November 2024, such as a model agro-industrial estate, raising the value of rice, and fisheries and livestock. It noted the plans of 3 subcommittees: fisheries, the draft longan strategy law, and the development of water sources and land for agriculture, which has a plan in 3 stages, from flood prevention, drawing on the floods in the North, to adding value to farm products
it: Issues for discussion with executives of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives (8 November 2024)
Plans of the subcommittees on fisheries · the draft longan strategy law · water sources and land for agriculture

te: Preparing discussions with the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives and 19 of its agencies
se: The meeting prepared a trip to discuss and exchange views with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and the executives of 19 agencies under the ministry, such as the Rice Department, the Royal Irrigation Department, the Department of Fisheries, the Department of Livestock Development and the Rubber Authority of Thailand, to learn about their policies, plans and urgent matters, and the issues where the committee can help push for concrete solutions
it: Trip to discuss matters with the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives and 19 of its agencies

te: 2 draft laws assigned, and subcommittees set up in 3 areas
se: The meeting noted that the committee has been assigned to study 2 draft Acts under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure: the draft law amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance and the draft Longan Strategy Act. It noted the National Strategy, the master plans, the 13th National Economic and Social Development Plan and the government's agricultural policy, for use in drawing up its work plan. It approved the appointment of committee secretaries and resolved to set up subcommittees in 3 areas: field and horticultural crops, fisheries and livestock, and soil and water
it: Study of draft Acts under rule 119 of the Rules of Procedure: the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ...., and the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. ....
National Strategy, master plans, the national development plan and the government's agricultural policy
Appointment of committee secretaries
Subcommittees set up in 3 areas (field and horticultural crops · fisheries and livestock · soil and water)

te: Understanding the committee's duties, and setting timeframes for subcommittees
se: The meeting noted an overview of the committee's duties and powers, the appointment of people to assist its work, and the setting up of subcommittees, which must work within 120 days, extendable by 60 days, for no more than 180 days in total. Each committee member may nominate 1 committee secretaries. The meeting agreed to give views on the draft ASEAN resolution on responsible investment in agriculture, food and forestry, assigned the secretariat to summarise the facts on land allocation in cooperative settlements, and agreed to look into farmers' hardships, with a focus on cutting production costs
it: The committee's duties and powers, and the timeframe for subcommittees (120 + 60 days)
Appointment of committee secretaries
Draft resolution of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly on responsible investment in agriculture, food and forestry
Problems with land allocation in cooperative settlements

te: First meeting: chair and other officers elected, and a direction for the work set
se: The meeting elected the committee's officers under rule 87 of the Senate Rules of Procedure B.E. 2562 (2019). Mr. Thawat Surabal was elected Chair of the committee, which has 18 members in all. The Chair proposed working principles based on the interests of the people and the nation, and a preliminary set of issues, such as applying the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy to develop agriculture, following up the government's agricultural policy, urgent fisheries problems, modern agriculture and increasing the competitiveness of Thai farm products
it: Election of the chair, vice-chairs, secretary, spokespersons and other officers of the committee
Working principles and a preliminary set of agricultural issues

te: Study of the draft amendment to the Fisheries Royal Ordinance
se: Agenda: study of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ...., under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure (the Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)

te: The Department of Fisheries heard on Thai fishing boats in the area of overlapping maritime claims, and preventive measures proposed
se: The meeting invited the Department of Fisheries to give information on the incident involving Thai fishing boats in the area of overlapping maritime claims with Myanmar. The department explained the steps it had taken, such as warnings through the fishing vessel monitoring centre and notices to fishers. The meeting proposed that agencies urgently work for the return of the crew and boats to Thailand, organise patrols with maritime security agencies, add the overlapping area boundaries to the vessel monitoring system, and provide relief for those affected
it: The incident involving Thai fishing boats in the area of overlapping maritime claims

te: Draft report considered, from small-scale fisheries to penalties
se: The meeting considered the draft report on the study of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ...., on small-scale fisheries, commercial fisheries, fishing outside Thai waters, exemptions for marine mammals and rare aquatic animals, fishing gear and purse seines, serious violations and penalties. It assigned the secretariat to gather the views and carefully revise the report once more
it: Draft report on the study of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ....

te: Every section of the draft fisheries law considered
se: The meeting completed its consideration of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. .... proposed by the Council of Ministers, continuing from the previous meeting, covering acts treated as serious violations, penalties, the transfer of fishing licences to heirs, fees and transitional provisions, and assigned the secretariat to gather the observations to prepare a draft report
it: Draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ....: draft sections 30–36

te: Draft section 29 on the administrative measures committee considered, and site visits planned
se: According to the press release of the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives, the meeting considered draft section 29 of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ...., on the administrative measures committee and the release of aquatic animals into fishing grounds, and proposed site visits to Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket Provinces to hear fishers' problems
it: Draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ....: draft section 29
Plan for site visits to study fisheries problems in Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket Provinces
